title.zh: Anthropic CEO白宫饭局后改口风：AI有风险，但美国要「安全地赢」
title.en: Anthropic CEO白宫饭局后改口风：AI有风险，但美国要「安全地赢」

current_state.zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei dropped his call to slow AI development after White House meetings with President Trump, shifting to a "win safely" framing while joining Google, Meta, OpenAI, xAI and Nvidia in signing a voluntary AI safety agreement.
current_state.en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei dropped his call to slow AI development after White House meetings with President Trump, shifting to a "win safely" framing while joining Google, Meta, OpenAI, xAI and Nvidia in signing a voluntary AI safety agreement.
